shared_elements: incised linear decoration (zigzag/chevron band on B; grooved lines on A)
justification: A depicts a human (or anthropomorphic) head with eyes, nose, a grinning row of teeth and a tiered coiffure or headdress carved in relief, while B is a plain cylindrical vessel whose only ornament is a narrow incised zigzag band below the rim. The sole common feature is the presence of incised linear grooving, which is a universal decorative device and carries no evidence of shared iconography; there is no shared figural subject, relationship or arrangement.
